names.legendary: Skarn, the Soup Runner of the North

lore.common: Sprays a perfect rooster tail of snow over anyone who says they aren't cold.
lore.uncommon: Chews snow with its back track and spits tiny icicles into the driver's scarf.
lore.rare: Vanishes between pine trees in a puff of powder, leaving only a trail of laughing exhaust.
lore.epic: Crossed a frozen lake at such speed that its wake piled snow into a bridge. The fishermen charged admission to cross it.
lore.legendary: Skarn delivered soup through a seven-day polar storm without losing a single drop. The soup was so hot the aurora came down to warm its hands.

names.legendary: Velocetta, Duchess of the Last Bend

lore.common: Revs dramatically outside the café, then drives away at precisely thirty kilometres an hour.
lore.uncommon: Has such a low nose that a speed bump looks like a mountain range.
lore.rare: Takes a hairpin bend so smoothly that the passenger's ice cream doesn't lean, even when gravity does.
lore.epic: Raced its own echo around the mountain circuit and beat it to the finish by a full lap. The crowd applauded twice.
lore.legendary: Velocetta once challenged the dawn to a race along the coast. She arrived before the sun, ordered breakfast and left a tip for the horizon.

names.legendary: Cindervale, Queen of the Last Railway

lore.common: Puffs smoke directly into the faces of waving passengers, then whistles goodbye.
lore.uncommon: Demands another shovel of coal before it has finished chewing the last.
lore.rare: Whistles through a mountain tunnel so strongly that the echo reaches the valley ahead of the train.
lore.epic: Pulled an endless procession of carriages across a frozen pass, melting the snow into a glowing ribbon of rails.
lore.legendary: Cindervale carried the last letters between two cities divided by a century of winter. Each envelope arrived warm, and the ink smelled faintly of coal and hope.

names.legendary: Tankor, Carrier of the Hundred Rivers

lore.common: Swishes its cargo around corners like an enormous bathtub with wheels.
lore.uncommon: Complains that every filling station is too small for a proper snack.
lore.rare: Transports a whole lake without spilling a drop, despite taking every roundabout the long way.
lore.epic: Rolled into a waterless festival and unleashed a river of drinking water from its silver belly. The queue formed before it parked.
lore.legendary: Tankor carried the last clean spring across the continent when the wells fell silent. The water never spoiled, and wherever he rested a fountain bloomed.

names.legendary: Cabalor, Ferryman of the Last Fare

lore.common: Switches its roof light off at the instant a soaking pedestrian waves.
lore.uncommon: Runs its meter whenever anybody says this is taking longer than expected.
lore.rare: Knows an impossible shortcut through every city, but the passengers must tolerate its opinions on traffic.
lore.epic: Carved a route through a gridlocked metropolis so quick that the rival taxis accused it of owning secret streets.
lore.legendary: Cabalor runs a black-and-gold cab that appears whenever someone is truly lost. Its meter charges one remembered story, and the destination is always home.

names.legendary: Towbrutus, the Last Road Home

lore.common: Arrives exactly after the broken car starts again. It looks disappointed.
lore.uncommon: Winds its hook around anything left unattended, including shopping trolleys and garden gates.
lore.rare: Lifts an entire stranded bus from a muddy ditch while the passengers finish their sandwiches.
lore.epic: Dragged a thousand snowbound cars into a single enormous convoy and led them through the mountain pass like a steel caterpillar.
lore.legendary: Towbrutus crosses highways that have fallen from every map, guided by the blink of one stranded hazard light. No traveller who accepts its rusty hook is ever left behind.

names.legendary: Tellurax, Waker of Buried Kingdoms

lore.common: Turns every neat garden bed into something resembling a mole convention.
lore.uncommon: Digs up weeds, then proudly plants them in a different row.
lore.rare: Can churn a field so perfectly that the worms stand in lines and salute.
lore.epic: Raked the valley overnight and uncovered the mayor's buried campaign promises, neatly labelled by year.
lore.legendary: Beneath every sleeping field, Tellurax hears the roots of forgotten forests. Its iron teeth can wake an orchard from centuries of silence.

names.legendary: Balegor, the Rolling Harvest King

lore.common: Spits out a perfectly neat bale exactly where the tractor wanted to turn.
lore.uncommon: Ties its bales so tightly that the farmer needs three neighbours and a heroic pair of scissors.
lore.rare: Swallows an entire field of straw, then accidentally wraps the farmer's lunch into a very expensive parcel.
lore.epic: Rolled hundreds of giant hay bales into a fortress around the barn. The cows elected a queen and refused to come out.
lore.legendary: Balegor made the first round hay bale when a king ordered the harvest carried home before dusk. It rolled the golden harvest across seven valleys, never losing a single stalk.

names.legendary: Ageron, Carver of the First Field

lore.common: Clangs against the only buried stone in the field and wakes every worm in the district.
lore.uncommon: Turns the soil over and leaves the worms wondering whether they have moved house.
lore.rare: Draws impossibly straight furrows across hills that used to be crooked. The farmer has started using them as rulers.
lore.epic: Carved a hundred fields before sunrise so the harvest could be planted ahead of a legendary storm. The crows cheered from the fences.
lore.legendary: Ageron carved the first furrow in an island of bare rock. The harvest grew so enormous that the island floated away under its weight; sailors now call it Breadland.

names.legendary: Sowerion, Keeper of the Sleeping Fields

lore.common: Drops seeds along the road and is followed by an enthusiastic parade of pigeons.
lore.uncommon: Plants lines so straight that the scarecrow starts checking them with a ruler.
lore.rare: Can sow an entire field before the farmer has finished his morning tea. The weeds demand equal treatment.
lore.epic: Planted seeds through the whole valley at dawn. By noon the fields had become a patchwork of green stripes visible from the hills.
lore.legendary: Sowerion sowed a thousand empty fields with one enchanted seed. Every furrow sprouted a different kind of bread, and the farmers still quarrel about who gets the croissants.

names.legendary: Brendara, the White Road Warden

lore.common: Clears the street beautifully, then piles a snow wall across the only driveway with a waiting car.
lore.uncommon: Jingles its tyre chains like Christmas bells, even in July. The other lorries are embarrassed.
lore.rare: Carves a tunnel through towering drifts without spilling the driver's coffee. The tunnel has its own echo.
lore.epic: Pushed three winters' worth of snow into one mountain in the town square. The council had to print ski passes.
lore.legendary: Brendara crossed the mountain pass when even the wolves stayed indoors, delivering a single birthday cake to the lighthouse keeper. The candles were still lit.

names.legendary: Ploughthor, the Beast Beneath the Fields

lore.common: Blocks the country lane at six kilometres an hour and waves cheerfully at the queue.
lore.uncommon: Flings a perfect stripe of mud onto the freshly painted farm gate.
lore.rare: Drags a buried oak stump out of the ground, complete with a furious family of squirrels.
lore.epic: Ploughed the whole county in a single moonlit night, leaving fields arranged into a giant picture of a smiling potato.
lore.legendary: Ploughthor was forged around a forgotten seed deep in the earth. Each spring his iron wheels awaken sleeping fields, and the oldest farmers leave him a mug of tea at the first furrow.

names.legendary: Ascendia, the Twin of the Mountain

lore.common: Creeps up the hill so slowly that people jog past it on the steps.
lore.uncommon: Argues with its descending twin about whose turn it is to see the summit.
lore.rare: Can climb any slope, even the side of a stone chimney. Passengers clutch their tickets as though that helps.
lore.epic: One winter it pulled a whole hillside railway up and over the mountain to avoid a landslide. The passengers arrived at an entirely new village.
lore.legendary: Ascendia was forged with two hearts: one always rising, one always falling. When both carriages meet, the mountain holds its breath.

names.legendary: Sir Junction, Emperor of the Attic Rails

lore.common: Circles the attic while grown-ups insist it belongs to the children. The children are not allowed to touch it.
lore.uncommon: Vanishes into a tiny tunnel for hours. Emerging with a new coat of soot is apparently a private matter.
lore.rare: Changes its own points and sends the miniature passengers to the model cow field instead of the station.
lore.epic: At midnight its railway expanded across every room in the house. The cat woke up as stationmaster and charged everyone for crossing the hallway.
lore.legendary: Sir Junction has travelled ten million miles without leaving a single attic. Every miniature station along his line holds a clock showing the exact moment the owner's childhood ended.

names.legendary: Unirion, Guardian of the Single Path

lore.common: Runs on one rail and is deeply offended by trains that need two.
lore.uncommon: Glides above the cafés and steals their sunlight. The customers now order breakfast in the shade.
lore.rare: Travels between towers so silently that passengers arrive before their conversations have finished.
lore.epic: Coiled its single track around the city skyline in a spiral. Commuters arrived at work with spectacular views and completely forgotten appointments.
lore.legendary: Unirion laid a silver path across a kingdom divided by mountains. The line never touches the ground, and no traveller aboard has ever been lost to the clouds.

names.legendary: Puffington, Engineer of the Lost Track

lore.common: Derails at the one corner its owner has repaired fourteen times.
lore.uncommon: Pulls three tiny carriages together by magnets and gets separated by the family dog.
lore.rare: Disappears beneath the sofa and returns hauling forgotten toys as passengers.
lore.epic: Laid new tracks across the entire house in one night, turning breakfast into a railway crossing and the bath into the final station.
lore.legendary: Puffington drives an invisible railway between the dreams of sleeping children. Each night he delivers a forgotten toy to the pillow that misses it most.

names.legendary: Railazar, the Train That Carried Dawn

lore.common: Arrives two minutes late, then leaves just before the passenger reaches the door.
lore.uncommon: Rattles every cup of coffee into the lap of its most optimistic commuter.
lore.rare: Roars through a mountain tunnel and wakes hibernating bears on the other side.
lore.epic: Grew enough carriages to carry an entire sleeping city to the coast, complete with beds, bakeries and one very confused mayor.
lore.legendary: Railazar's first journey crossed a valley where the sun could not rise. He returned carrying dawn in his windows, and every station clock along the line began ticking towards morning.

names.legendary: Skyrider Voss, Lord of White Ascent

lore.common: Swings as soon as somebody reaches for the safety bar. It says it is keeping things exciting.
lore.uncommon: Collects every glove dropped on the way up. Its secret collection could dress a giant.
lore.rare: Stops halfway to the summit whenever anyone has just finished a large hot chocolate.
lore.epic: Raced up the mountain with a hundred skiers still holding their mugs. The entire resort received an unexpected hot-chocolate snowfall.
lore.legendary: Skyrider Voss carries travellers above storms where the peaks kiss the stars. Once he gave a snowman a free ride, and that snowman now rules the summit.

names.legendary: Altivia, Warden of the Hanging Valley

lore.common: Fogs up on cold days, so everyone draws smiley faces on the glass and the view disappears.
lore.uncommon: Fogs its windows so completely that the passengers can only admire their own drawings.
lore.rare: Floats above the trees and politely asks the eagles not to race it.
lore.epic: Carried every skier to safety ahead of a mountain storm, then returned to rescue a forgotten sandwich.
lore.legendary: Altivia hangs between two peaks where no trail survives. She ferries lost travellers across the clouds, but demands one story before she opens the cabin door.

names.legendary: Tramiel, the Bell of Lost Streets

lore.common: Rings at pedestrians who pretend not to see the tracks beneath their feet.
lore.uncommon: Glides through the market and steals the smell of fresh waffles through its open windows.
lore.rare: Draws sparks from overhead wires, spelling secret messages across the evening sky.
lore.epic: Grew rails through the heart of a traffic jam and escorted an entire parade of stranded commuters home without stopping once.
lore.legendary: Tramiel remembers the cobblestone streets that modern cities paved over. On foggy evenings his bell calls ghostly platforms to life, and forgotten neighbourhoods briefly return for one last ride.

names.legendary: Tidehauler, Keeper of the Last Launch

lore.common: Refuses to go the right way when reversing. The driver insists the steering wheel is haunted.
lore.uncommon: Tucks its boat in so snugly that the boat cries when the straps come off.
lore.rare: Backed halfway into the sea and came out towing a submarine. Nobody can find a receipt.
lore.epic: Launched every yacht in the harbour at once, then rolled down the ramp after them. The marina is considering charging it mooring fees.
lore.legendary: Long after sailors disappear, Tidehauler returns their boats to the sea. No vessel may leave the shore until the old wheels have creaked their blessing.

names.legendary: Haulthazar, Keeper of the Chrome Herd

lore.common: Transports ten sparkling cars and delivers all ten with matching bird droppings.
lore.uncommon: Stacks vehicles in tidy rows like biscuits, then gets very upset if one is a different colour.
lore.rare: Can make cars climb aboard by honking in a mysterious language. The hatchbacks are especially obedient.
lore.epic: Rolled through a city towing a thousand self-driving cars like an iron centipede. Every parking garage declared independence.
lore.legendary: Haulthazar herds the newborn cars of the world to their first owners. Legends say he once delivered a chariot to a king before the wheel had been invented.

names.legendary: Trailorax, Bearer of Fallen Cities

lore.common: Spills one shovel of rubble on every speed bump. Considers it a tip.
lore.uncommon: Rattles behind the tractor like a kitchen drawer full of angry spoons.
lore.rare: Can carry a stone wall without a scratch, but loses its temper at one brick.
lore.epic: Tipped an entire demolished tower into the wrong field. By morning the sheep had built a fortress and appointed a general.
lore.legendary: Trailorax carried the last stones of the old capital away from the advancing sea. Each one still rattles inside its bed, waiting to become a new city.

names.legendary: Atlas Flatback, Carrier of Small Towns

lore.common: Lets one loose strap flap on the motorway like an enthusiastic wave.
lore.uncommon: Carries a stack of boards tied together mostly by optimism.
lore.rare: Can haul an entire house across the county without rattling a single teacup.
lore.epic: Rolled through the town with a house wider than the road. The lampposts politely bent aside, and the traffic lights asked for a day off.
lore.legendary: Atlas Flatback carried the last building of a village away from a rising flood. The people followed on foot and planted a new town wherever its wheels finally rested.

names.legendary: Lady Bridlebox of the Endless Road

lore.common: Sounds like a tap-dancing pony whenever it hits a bump in the road.
lore.uncommon: Carries a hay net so irresistible that its passenger refuses to leave at the show.
lore.rare: Retracts its ramp whenever a horse approaches. The pony has learned to negotiate with carrots.
lore.epic: Rolled into the county show with a hundred horses all insisting on first place. The judges fled into the refreshments tent.
lore.legendary: Bridlebox once carried the last wild pony through a blizzard without a single jolt. Spring flowers bloomed along every hoofprint when its doors finally opened.

names.legendary: Old Ironpine, Last Forest Bearer

lore.common: Leaves a trail of bark through town so obvious that even the squirrels can follow it.
lore.uncommon: Sings creaky pinewood lullabies to every log riding on its back.
lore.rare: Hauls an entire hillside's timber up a road the mountain goats refuse to climb.
lore.epic: Rolled into the sawmill carrying a whole oak, roots and all, with twelve furious squirrels still living in it. Construction was postponed for negotiations.
lore.legendary: Old Ironpine once carried the last giant tree out of a burning valley and planted it on the highest hill. The truck's wheels have grown rings of wood ever since.

names.legendary: Gravelord, Titan of the Four Wheels

lore.common: Parks beside an ordinary car and asks whether the little thing is its baby.
lore.uncommon: Wears tyres taller than people and enjoys making puddles everyone's problem.
lore.rare: Clears a row of buses in one jump and lands so gently the driver doesn't spill the fizzy drink.
lore.epic: Leapt over the entire demolition derby and landed in the stadium's VIP seats. The scoreboard surrendered and displayed ONE BIG TRUCK.
lore.legendary: Gravelord once climbed a mountain of wrecked cars and roared until the iron itself trembled. At sunrise the scrap heap rolled away on four impossible wheels.

names.legendary: Gritsworth, the Frostbreaker

lore.common: Throws a handful of salt onto every freshly polished car and accelerates away innocently.
lore.uncommon: Has a spinning tail that makes every pigeon in town think somebody is scattering breadcrumbs.
lore.rare: Melts a dangerous patch of black ice before anyone else sees it. The sledging club files a complaint.
lore.epic: Cleared every frozen road before dawn, leaving a glittering white trail visible from the hills. The snowmen held a protest march.
lore.legendary: Gritsworth has guarded the mountain pass through forty savage winters. Even the snowflakes know to move aside when his spinning salt wheel starts singing.

names.legendary: Axlethor, the Endless Caravan

lore.common: Waits for a tractor unit to collect it and sulks when the wrong one arrives.
lore.uncommon: Reverses into the loading bay with one wheel on the painted line, making the warehouse manager twitch.
lore.rare: Unfolds its doors into a hidden loading dock where lost parcels queue for collection.
lore.epic: Joined a convoy of freight trailers so long that the first driver reached home while the last was still leaving the depot.
lore.legendary: Axlethor carries a hundred vanished highways inside his steel ribs. Unhitch him at a crossroads and forgotten towns appear on the map again, complete with impatient delivery drivers.

names.legendary: Madame Grime, Queen of the Last Sweep

lore.common: Wakes the entire street at six, then politely vacuums up the complaint letters.
lore.uncommon: Wears two rotating brush moustaches. Every pigeon in town thinks it is the mayor.
lore.rare: Drinks an entire autumn from the gutters and coughs up a perfectly sorted leaf collection.
lore.epic: Swept a carnival clean before the last clown left. The clown came back to find even his painted footsteps missing.
lore.legendary: Madame Grime has guarded the same cobblestones for centuries, collecting every lost promise in her dust hopper. Return the right coin and she remembers your name.

names.legendary: Haulkin, the Smallest Mountain Mover

lore.common: Carries a single pebble everywhere and calls it freight.
lore.uncommon: Tips its plastic bed to unload dirt directly onto a clean carpet.
lore.rare: Moves a whole army of action figures across the garden, collecting fares in acorns.
lore.epic: Hauled every grain from a playground sandpit in one afternoon and built a magnificent sandcastle in the headteacher's office.
lore.legendary: Haulkin once moved a fallen mountain one teaspoon of gravel at a time so a family of ants could return home. His little wheels still bear the scratches of the journey.

names.legendary: Rigmar, the Endless Road Hauler

lore.common: Honks its enormous air horn at a waving child and frightens every parent in the car.
lore.uncommon: Wears polished chrome exhaust stacks like a pair of magnificent metal antlers.
lore.rare: Navigates an impossible hairpin turn without spilling a single box of eggs, then knocks over the road sign.
lore.epic: Carried an entire travelling carnival through a mountain tunnel and emerged with the Ferris wheel spinning between its trailers.
lore.legendary: Rigmar delivers supplies along roads that no longer exist, guided by fading stars painted on his cab. He once transported a village's entire winter harvest through a blizzard with every candle still burning.

names.legendary: Haulazar, the Truck That Carried a City

lore.common: Crunches its gears through a quiet village at dawn, waking every dog.
lore.uncommon: Parks across the whole street to deliver one very small parcel.
lore.rare: Carries a full house of furniture without rattling a single china cup, then misplaces the front door.
lore.epic: Rolled up to a flooded town with supplies for everyone and unfolded its trailers into a temporary street of shops and kitchens.
lore.legendary: Haulazar once carried the gates of a shattered city across the desert so its people could start again. The wheels left tracks that travellers still follow when they need courage to go on.

names.legendary: Vandra, the House That Travels

lore.common: Claims the loading zone just long enough for the traffic warden to arrive.
lore.uncommon: Its sliding door clatters awake three sleeping streets.
lore.rare: Fits three sofas and a piano inside but refuses one last houseplant.
lore.epic: Swallowed an entire moving day's furniture, then unloaded a dining room into the wrong wedding reception. Guests politely sat down to eat.
lore.legendary: Carried every possession of a village fleeing a flood. When they opened its doors on dry ground, the whole village unfolded inside, right down to the bakery's bell.

names.legendary: Automatus, Oracle of Insufficient Funds

lore.common: Swallows your card when you're in a hurry, then displays a cheerful thank-you message.
lore.uncommon: Charges a tiny fee for checking your balance. Somehow the fee has its own fee.
lore.rare: Dispenses exactly the notes needed for something you weren't planning to buy. Budgeting has become impossible.
lore.epic: Opened every cash drawer in the city at once and paid all the bank executives in arcade tokens. The shareholders called it disruption.
lore.legendary: Automatus knows the balance of every fortune that ever existed. It can print a million banknotes in a second, but still asks if you would like a receipt.

names.legendary: Lullavelle, Keeper of the Sleeping Road

lore.common: Squeaks on every cobblestone but falls silent the second someone tries to find the squeaky wheel.
lore.uncommon: Pulls its hood down like a turtle shell when it rains. Refuses to emerge until offered a biscuit.
lore.rare: Can glide over the roughest path without waking its tiny passenger. The exhausted parents call it a miracle on wheels.
lore.epic: Rolled through a grand parade with a dozen sleeping babies aboard, perfectly undisturbed by fireworks and brass bands. The marching band requested lessons.
lore.legendary: Lullavelle travels the roads between waking and dreaming. Wherever its wheels pass, troubled sleepers find rest, and every parent discovers the mythical hot cup of coffee.

names.legendary: Dollandra, Titan of Tiny Wheels

lore.common: Tips itself over when someone says the load is perfectly balanced.
lore.uncommon: Carries an impossible tower of boxes and complains about the one envelope on top.
lore.rare: Can lift a grand piano over a staircase, provided someone promises not to mention gravity.
lore.epic: Escaped the loading bay with an entire office balanced on its platform. The manager chased it for six blocks holding a clipboard.
lore.legendary: Dollandra ferried the stones that built the ancient citadel, one trip at a time. The architects took all the credit; the wheels are still squeaking about it.

names.legendary: Atlas Jr, the Two-Wheeled Titan

lore.common: Clunks over every step like a tiny angry drummer on a staircase.
lore.uncommon: Tilts backward with three boxes aboard and announces that all three are now its passengers.
lore.rare: Carries a tower of crates through a crowded market without bruising a single apple.
lore.epic: Moved the town hall's entire furniture collection in one trip. The council discovered its meeting was now taking place in the bakery.
lore.legendary: Atlas Jr hauled the first mountain of winter firewood into a frozen village on two squeaky wheels. Its tracks remain in the snow even through midsummer.

names.legendary: Count Trolleoni, Master of Departures

lore.common: Has one wheel that points firmly toward the nearest stranger's ankles.
lore.uncommon: Carries twelve suitcases and a suspiciously heavy bag marked 'just essentials'.
lore.rare: Escapes the airport ramp and arrives at the hotel before the luggage does.
lore.epic: Marshalled every abandoned trolley into a steel convoy, blocking the airport until someone returned the fifty-cent coins.
lore.legendary: Count Trolleoni once carried the possessions of an entire migrating city through a blizzard. His wheels still turn at the sound of a departure announcement.

names.legendary: Palletus Maximus, King of the Aisles

lore.common: Squeaks every time the handle is pumped, loudly enough to summon the shift supervisor.
lore.uncommon: Slides its forks beneath a pallet, then gets stuck on a single grain of gravel.
lore.rare: Moves a towering stack of boxes without rattling one. The forklift is openly jealous.
lore.epic: Rearranged every pallet in the warehouse overnight into an enormous maze. The morning shift reached the coffee machine after three heroic hours.
lore.legendary: Palletus Maximus dragged the final shipment through a blizzard after every engine froze. The entire port still marks his twin tracks in gold on the loading bay floor.

names.legendary: Pramadora, Guardian of the First Journey

lore.common: Develops a squeak exactly when the baby finally falls asleep.
lore.uncommon: Has room for a sleeping baby, a mountain of blankets, and absolutely no groceries.
lore.rare: Glides over cobbles without waking its passenger, but rattles ferociously when empty.
lore.epic: Collected every dropped toy along the promenade until it resembled a travelling circus with a baby at the centre.
lore.legendary: Pramadora rolled an entire royal nursery through a coronation without waking a single infant. The king was crowned in a whisper and has spoken softly ever since.

names.legendary: Nannavroom, Guardian of the First Ride

lore.common: Refuses to fold in front of a bus driver. Folds instantly when nobody is watching.
lore.uncommon: Hides biscuits in its underseat basket. The pigeons follow it like a royal procession.
lore.rare: Carries four shopping bags, a sleepy baby and a toy dinosaur without dropping a crumb. The parents are less coordinated.
lore.epic: Rolled through the busiest market with a sleeping baby aboard, parting the crowds like a tiny unstoppable battleship.
lore.legendary: Nannavroom carried generations of newborns across a mountain village's impossible stairways. Even its squeakiest wheel fell silent whenever a baby dreamed.

names.legendary: Sir Bollivar, Guardian of the Kerb

lore.common: Is exactly shin height and cannot understand why pedestrians keep yelling.
lore.uncommon: Wears reflective stripes like ceremonial armour. Has never been invited to a ceremony.
lore.rare: Stopped a runaway shopping trolley so abruptly its groceries kept going to the next postcode.
lore.epic: Defended the entire market square from an invading fleet of delivery vans. The vans surrendered after the third U-turn.
lore.legendary: Sir Bollivar was forged to guard the first city street. Empires fell, roads changed, but not one wheel ever passed him without permission.

names.legendary: Count Carburettor, King of Chrome

lore.common: Spends six days being polished for a seven-minute drive. Proud of every second.
lore.uncommon: Has round headlights that look perpetually surprised by modern parking regulations.
lore.rare: Starts perfectly in freezing weather just to humiliate newer cars. The neighbourhood has noticed.
lore.epic: Led a procession of forgotten roadsters out of a museum and onto the highway. Every dashboard clock turned back fifty years.
lore.legendary: Count Carburettor carries the final spark of the golden age of motoring. He has crossed empires without satnav, but still refuses to ask for directions.

names.legendary: Combinarok, Titan of the Final Harvest

lore.common: Folds its enormous cutting teeth to squeeze through a gate. The gate is still nervous.
lore.uncommon: Spits straw behind itself like a dragon with hay fever. The birds call it free bedding.
lore.rare: Separates wheat from stones, weeds and the farmer's lost car keys in one pass. The keys emerge polished with a little paper label.
lore.epic: Devoured a valley of ripe wheat before the storm arrived. The farmers cheered until it began neatly threshing their garden hedges as well.
lore.legendary: Combinarok walks at the end of every summer, collecting the grain of a thousand fields into one golden heart. When it sleeps, entire villages bake bread from its dreams.

names.legendary: Solstice Vroom, Lord of Open Skies

lore.common: Puts its roof down precisely seven seconds before the rain starts.
lore.uncommon: Steals hairstyles at motorway speed and deposits them in the back seat.
lore.rare: Refuses to close its roof for anyone below aristocratic status, including its owner.
lore.epic: Led a parade of roofless sports cars through a thunderstorm. The resulting hairdos became a national fashion movement.
lore.legendary: Drives along the horizon collecting sunsets in its rear-view mirror. Once sold one to a billionaire, then opened the roof and let it escape.

names.legendary: Veyronyx, Prince of the Midnight Pass

lore.common: Has two doors and four passengers. The back two may need rescuing.
lore.uncommon: Refuses to park anywhere it might have to open its very long doors.
lore.rare: Leaves its reflection in every shop window so admirers can continue staring after it leaves.
lore.epic: Challenged the city's traffic lights to a duel and made every signal blush green. The parking inspectors declared it unfair magic.
lore.legendary: Was sculpted from moonlight and polished chrome by a forgotten road god. Every curve is perfect except the tiny back seat, a joke the god refuses to explain.

names.legendary: Discorius, Champion of the Endless Throw

lore.common: Hates being mistaken for a dinner plate. Has started throwing the plates back.
lore.uncommon: Never lands where it was aimed, but always lands where somebody left their lunch.
lore.rare: Circles the entire stadium before striking the bullseye on a target no one knew existed.
lore.epic: Spun so fast at the championship that it carved an Olympic ring around the stadium. The judges are still measuring the throw.
lore.legendary: The first champion cast Discorius toward the horizon. It has flown around the world ever since, returning every four years to demand a rematch.

names.legendary: Grathex, Keeper of the Lost Streets

lore.common: Eats dropped coins. Claims it has never tasted a single one.
lore.uncommon: Whispers from beneath the pavement whenever someone mentions sewer maintenance.
lore.rare: Can swallow a whole bicycle through its narrow gaps. The cyclist now commutes by train.
lore.epic: Opened beneath the mayor's ceremonial carriage and swallowed the entire procession. Everyone emerged at the town fountain wearing boots full of water.
lore.legendary: Grathex has guarded the tunnels below the oldest city for nine hundred years. Every lost key rests in its iron teeth, awaiting the one owner it remembers.

names.legendary: Voltrion, Knight of the Quiet Road

lore.common: Sneaks through car parks so quietly the shopping trolleys jump.
lore.uncommon: Treats every charging station like a social club. Will not leave without gossip.
lore.rare: Can whisper along an empty motorway without waking a single bird, then honks at a pigeon.
lore.epic: Challenged the petrol cars to a race and arrived first, silently. The spectators were still waiting for the starting roar.
lore.legendary: Voltrion raced a thunderbolt across six kingdoms and won without a sound. The thunder arrived three hours late, demanded a rematch and has been practicing silent starts ever since.

names.legendary: Velocitor, King of the Last Lap

lore.common: Arrives at the pit stop demanding four fresh tyres and a tiny cup of espresso. It never drinks the espresso.
lore.uncommon: Its front wing is so proud of its downforce that it refuses to turn when someone says up.
lore.rare: Takes corners at impossible angles. Has left tyre marks on a driver's very surprised lunchbox.
lore.epic: Overtook its own shadow on the final straight. The shadow demanded a safety car and an apology.
lore.legendary: Velocitor once raced the setting sun across the desert circuit and won by a wheel. Sunrise has refused to enter another Grand Prix.

names.legendary: Aerodiscus, the Eternal Return

lore.common: Lands in the tree every time you throw it, and someone has to climb up.
lore.uncommon: Refuses to come back to its owner, but always returns to the dog that wasn't playing.
lore.rare: Rides a breeze around corners, trees and an extremely confused cricket match.
lore.epic: Soared through an outdoor wedding and collected every hat before landing in the cake. The bride now insists it was part of the ceremony.
lore.legendary: Cast into the sky a thousand years ago, Aerodiscus still circles the world awaiting its thrower. Every spring it returns to the same park for a game of fetch.

names.legendary: Little Hatchwell, Queen of Tight Spaces

lore.common: Opens its boot only to let one escaped orange roll into the gutter.
lore.uncommon: Fits six shopping bags, a pushchair and a suspiciously large plant into a boot nobody trusts.
lore.rare: Squeezes into a parking space so narrow that the neighbouring cars have to breathe in.
lore.epic: Carried the entire village fête home in a single trip. The bumper was festooned with bunting and the boot still had room for cake.
lore.legendary: Little Hatchwell found a parking space outside the royal palace on festival day. The court declared it a miracle, and the space is still protected by ceremonial traffic cones.

names.legendary: Lady Everrest, the Gentle Farewell

lore.common: Polishes its windows until they reflect the sky. It takes its time on important journeys.
lore.uncommon: Moves through town so quietly that even the pigeons pause on the pavement.
lore.rare: Keeps every flower upright along the winding road, never allowing a petal to fall before its time.
lore.epic: Led a farewell procession through a town where the street clocks stopped together for one minute. The journey continued when everyone was ready.
lore.legendary: Lady Everrest knows every road that leads a family to its last goodbye. No traveller is ever hurried, and the flowers she carries bloom again beside the path in spring.

names.legendary: Puckorius, the Eternal Overtime

lore.common: Hides under the sofa for months after one friendly match in the hallway.
lore.uncommon: Slides across the ice like a runaway biscuit with anger issues.
lore.rare: Ricochets off three goalposts and a goalkeeper's helmet before finding the net. Nobody claims the assist.
lore.epic: Flew through the arena at the championship final and knocked every spectator's popcorn into perfect little piles. The crowd demanded instant replay.
lore.legendary: Puckorius was struck during the longest hockey final ever played. Legend says it still skims a frozen lake each winter, searching for the winning goal that the referee never saw.

names.legendary: Rumbleford, King of the Three Engines

lore.common: Drinks an entire tank of fuel to drive to the next petrol pump.
lore.uncommon: Wears flames on its bonnet and gets jealous of actual fire.
lore.rare: Leaves a pair of smoking tyre marks that arrange themselves into its autograph.
lore.epic: Revved so fiercely at the county race that every painted flame on its body jumped off and ran the course on foot. The flames came second.
lore.legendary: Rumbleford was built from three rival racing cars, each with a legendary engine. They still argue about steering, so it drives in three directions at once.

names.legendary: Admiral Aircushion of the Uncrossed Sea

lore.common: Sprays everyone waiting at the ferry terminal and calls it a complimentary shower.
lore.uncommon: Skims across mud so happily that stranded boats write it angry letters.
lore.rare: Rides a cushion of air over roads, marshes and puddles without noticing a single obstacle.
lore.epic: Crossed the channel during the great fog, leading a convoy of lost ships with its roaring engines. The lighthouse filed a noise complaint.
lore.legendary: When the sea swallowed the old coast road, Admiral Aircushion carried an entire village to dry land. Its rubber skirt still bears the footprints of a thousand rescued boots.

names.legendary: Electrolina, Queen of Two Hearts

lore.common: Turns its engine off at red lights just to watch the driver panic.
lore.uncommon: Swaps from battery to petrol whenever the radio plays a dramatic song.
lore.rare: Glides past sleeping towns without a sound, then purrs loudly at the first hill.
lore.epic: Led a hundred hybrids silently through a busy city. The traffic wardens thought every car had stalled and started issuing tickets.
lore.legendary: Electrolina carries two beating engines, one fed by lightning and one by flame. On the night of the great blackout, she pulled the city's dawn parade through the darkness.

names.legendary: Lady Lengthington, Duchess of the Mile

lore.common: Needs six attempts to take a corner and insists that everyone admire the effort.
lore.uncommon: Its front reaches the venue before the back has even left home.
lore.rare: Carries twelve passengers, three cakes and an orchestra in the rear seat without disturbing a single glass.
lore.epic: Picked up the entire graduating class for prom without stopping. The tail end was still outside the school when the front arrived at the ballroom.
lore.legendary: Lady Lengthington once carried two feuding royal families to a wedding, each convinced they had booked a different carriage. By the end of the journey they had shared tea and forgotten the argument.

names.legendary: Lord Holloway, Keeper of the Roads Below

lore.common: Waits until the street is quiet to make a mysterious dripping noise beneath your feet.
lore.uncommon: Calls the names of passing workers from somewhere far below the pavement.
lore.rare: Connects two streets with a tunnel that wasn't on any map. Delivery drivers are delighted and slightly alarmed.
lore.epic: Opened the city's underground passageways for a midnight parade of forgotten umbrellas, toy boats and very well-dressed rats.
lore.legendary: Lord Holloway guards the oldest road beneath the city, where lost rivers still run. Those who hear his echo and follow it return with memories of places that no longer exist.

names.legendary: Lord Minimo, the Impossible Parking

lore.common: Scoots into the last parking gap on the street and leaves two SUVs arguing over whose space it stole.
lore.uncommon: Looks like a toy car someone fed breakfast to. Keeps asking when it will grow proper doors.
lore.rare: Slides through alleyways with the smug precision of a mouse through a keyhole. The alley cats now charge it tolls.
lore.epic: Led a revolt of tiny cars through the city's narrowest lanes. Traffic wardens surrendered after finding a parking ticket stuck to their own bicycles.
lore.legendary: Lord Minimo drove through the keyhole of the royal garage and stole the grand prize for parallel parking. It was awarded a space so small only a postage stamp could use it.

names.legendary: Duke Rumblehood, King of the Asphalt

lore.common: Growls at the traffic lights as though the little hatchback beside it is a rival dragon.
lore.uncommon: Gulps air through its bonnet scoop and spits out a roar that rattles nearby windows.
lore.rare: Burns a pair of tyre marks into the road like a giant autograph. The council keeps painting them out.
lore.epic: Led a fifty-car rumble through Main Street and shook the dough right out of the bakery ovens. The parade won first prize for loudest breakfast.
lore.legendary: Rumblehood ruled the desert highway by the sound of his V8 alone. Each dawn his engine thunder rolled across the salt flats, guiding lost drivers back to the road.

names.legendary: Lord Metron, Collector of Lost Minutes

lore.common: Swallows a coin, thinks about it for ten seconds, and then asks for another.
lore.uncommon: Counts down twice as fast while its owner is buying milk.
lore.rare: Prints a perfectly timed parking ticket the instant somebody says just one minute.
lore.epic: Started charging the pigeons for perching along the high street. The birds paid in bottle caps and somehow came out ahead.
lore.legendary: Lord Metron once stopped every parking clock in a besieged city so its citizens could evacuate without losing a minute. He still demands exact change from visiting kings.

names.legendary: Herald Cardo, Voice of the Forgotten

lore.common: Blocks everyone's view at a football match, then apologises by falling over.
lore.uncommon: Changes a protest slogan by one letter when nobody is watching. The march is now demanding more pears.
lore.rare: Makes even shy voices carry across the whole square when held above a crowd.
lore.epic: Marched itself through city hall and gathered every abandoned sign into a towering wall of demands. The mayor read every single one.
lore.legendary: Herald Cardo led a protest against bad weather, raising one sign towards the heavens. The clouds wrote WE HEAR YOU across the sky in rain, and the town applauded.

names.legendary: Veloce, Phantom of the Night Stage

lore.common: Spits pebbles around every corner and blames the tyres.
lore.uncommon: Gets mud on the roof even when the road is completely dry.
lore.rare: Takes hairpin bends so sharply that the navigator's map folds itself in fright.
lore.epic: Raced through a mountain rally so fast that the dust cloud finished two minutes behind the car. The spectators applauded the cloud anyway.
lore.legendary: Veloce ran the Midnight Rally of a Thousand Bends without headlights, following only the stars. Its glowing tyre tracks still guide lost drivers through the passes.

names.legendary: Vortexette, Queen of the Tiny Track

lore.common: Drives over everyone's slippers, then runs out of batteries beneath the sofa.
lore.uncommon: Takes a sharp turn around the coffee table and steals the dog's tennis ball.
lore.rare: Learns a racing line through the furniture so perfect that even the cat cannot intercept it.
lore.epic: Turned the family driveway into a full-sized Grand Prix overnight. The tiny cars raced, and the neighbours sold tickets from lawn chairs.
lore.legendary: Vortexette won a royal horse race by driving underneath every rival and across the finish line first. The horses now demand tiny racing helmets.

names.legendary: Signoria, Sentinel of the Last Safe Road

lore.common: Points left when everyone needs right, then blames the wind.
lore.uncommon: Rotates whenever somebody asks for directions and enjoys the confusion.
lore.rare: Changes its arrow to reveal the safest route when a road is flooded.
lore.epic: Rewrote every junction in the city into one gigantic roundabout. The mayor is still circling with a cup of cold coffee.
lore.legendary: Signoria pointed away from danger for a hundred winters. One day she turned her arrow upward, and the villagers found a staircase hidden in the clouds.

names.legendary: Velocetta, Duchess of the Mountain Pass

lore.common: Rattles over every speed bump and complains about the indignity.
lore.uncommon: Steals the driver's hat with a blast of wind whenever the roof comes down.
lore.rare: Takes the tightest mountain bends so smoothly that the passenger's coffee does not ripple.
lore.epic: Blazed through the old coastal road in a silver streak, leaving a trail of blooming wildflowers and furious traffic cameras.
lore.legendary: Velocetta won the first race across the Seven Peaks with no engine, only a stolen tailwind. Her chrome bonnet still catches the dawn before any other car.

names.legendary: Tallythor, Keeper of the Final Whistle

lore.common: Shows the wrong goal tally for half a second and watches the stands erupt.
lore.uncommon: Loses exactly one segment of a number, turning every eight into something suspicious.
lore.rare: Knows the winning score before the ball is kicked, but refuses to reveal it until the final minute.
lore.epic: Flashed a victory message so bright during the cup final that both teams celebrated at once. The referee had to borrow the scoreboard's glasses.
lore.legendary: Tallythor once counted every cheer in a legendary stadium and displayed the total across the night sky. The crowd needed three days to finish reading the number.

names.legendary: Signoria, the Name Above Every Door

lore.common: Squeaks outside the shop until a customer comes out to ask it to be quiet.
lore.uncommon: Rewrites today's special whenever the cook turns away. Somehow the soup is always cake.
lore.rare: Changes its lettering to lure passers-by into the little shop nobody noticed before.
lore.epic: Made every sign in the shopping street advertise the same mysterious bargain. Thousands arrived to discover it was a free hug from the florist.
lore.legendary: Signoria knows the true name of every place, even the ones erased from maps. Once a year her painted letters reveal a lost street and all its doors appear again at sunrise.

names.legendary: Minicarus, the Two-Seat City Conqueror

lore.common: Parks sideways in a gap so tiny that the other cars stop to stare.
lore.uncommon: Insists on carrying all the shopping in the passenger seat and buckles in a watermelon.
lore.rare: Can squeeze through a traffic jam so narrow that even bicycles have to wait.
lore.epic: Reorganised every parked vehicle in the city into neat little rows. The drivers emerged to find their cars arranged by colour and personality.
lore.legendary: Minicarus crossed an ancient city's seven hills without once asking for a wider road. The streets grew around its tiny wheels, and the city planners are still trying to work out how.

names.legendary: Topazion, the Point That Never Rested

lore.common: Spins beautifully for three seconds, then throws itself off the table into someone's soup.
lore.uncommon: Changes its painted stripes into a rainbow that refuses to stop moving.
lore.rare: Spins on the tip of a needle and balances an entire stack of teacups on its head.
lore.epic: Drilled through the ballroom floor during a competition, emerging in the cellar with every dancing couple still circling overhead.
lore.legendary: Topazion was spun on the day the great clock stopped. It has not toppled since, and the clock refuses to start without its permission.

names.legendary: Wagonetta, Keeper of the Back Seat

lore.common: Hides a sandwich under the back seat for six months and blames the children for the smell.
lore.uncommon: Carries so much luggage on its roof that low bridges tremble as it approaches.
lore.rare: Fits nine children, three dogs and a camping stove inside its boot without bending the laws of physics too visibly.
lore.epic: Swallowed an entire caravan's holiday supplies during packing, then arrived at the beach with a tent already pitched on its roof.
lore.legendary: Wagonetta carried seven generations of one family down the same winding summer road. Every time a child asks 'Are we there yet?', the road grows a mile shorter.

names.legendary: Carlotta, Queen of the Unbroken Axle

lore.common: Paints a tally mark on its bonnet every time it taps another bumper.
lore.uncommon: Drives in circles so much that it gets dizzy on straight roads.
lore.rare: Can thread a dented car through the narrowest gap in the pack without losing a single flake of paint.
lore.epic: Took the final corner so fiercely that the entire dirt oval rose into a wall of spinning dust. The crowd watched the finish on a cloud.
lore.legendary: Carlotta survived a hundred races without losing her battered number plate. When the track was demolished, she drove one last lap and the old grandstand stood up to cheer.

names.legendary: Octavia Stop, Keeper of the Crossing

lore.common: Stares down every driver with eight perfectly serious red corners.
lore.uncommon: Shouts STOP at passing tumbleweeds even when the road is empty.
lore.rare: Can halt a runaway carriage with one glowing red glance, but politely waves ducklings through.
lore.epic: Raised a wall of floating red octagons at the busiest crossroads, trapping the traffic in an endless game of musical chairs.
lore.legendary: Octavia stopped a falling star at the edge of a sleeping village. It still waits above the rooftops, perfectly still, for permission to land.

names.legendary: Luminar, Keeper of the Last Safe Street

lore.common: Flickers outside a bedroom window and insists it is just practising Morse code.
lore.uncommon: Attracts so many moths that they hold a tiny town meeting around its bulb each night.
lore.rare: Illuminates only the footsteps of people who have lost their way, leaving the rest of the street in peaceful darkness.
lore.epic: Turned every lamp along the boulevard into a tower of golden light, guiding a lost circus procession home through dense fog.
lore.legendary: Luminar was the final light burning when the great city fell silent. Travellers followed its glow across the dark for generations, and a new town grew beneath it.

names.legendary: Minivolt, Champion of the Tiny Track

lore.common: Parks squarely under a bare foot and waits for the scream.
lore.uncommon: Fits inside a pocket but insists on making engine noises at weddings.
lore.rare: Races along the skirting board and disappears behind the fridge for three seasons.
lore.epic: Escaped the toy box and raced a thousand miniature cars across the city, making a speed bump out of the mayor's slipper.
lore.legendary: Minivolt crossed the legendary racetrack made of falling dominoes without knocking a single one over. He still returns each night to challenge the reflection of his own headlights.

names.legendary: Lady Brassandra of the First Highway

lore.common: Leaks a spot of oil wherever it stops, leaving a very honest travel diary.
lore.uncommon: Toots its rubber horn proudly even when overtaken by bicycles.
lore.rare: Rolls through thick fog guided only by its polished brass headlamps.
lore.epic: Entered a modern motorway race at twenty miles an hour and won when all its rivals got stuck behind a tractor.
lore.legendary: Drove the first coast road before any maps existed, laying down shining tracks for every traveller after it. Its original passengers are still arguing about the radio.

names.legendary: Yorella, the Unbroken Return

lore.common: Falls to the ground and refuses to come back until someone apologises.
lore.uncommon: Sleeps at the end of its string with a smug little spin.
lore.rare: Can circle a runner's ankles without tangling once, even while the runner dances.
lore.epic: Duke Loopfinity walked the dog around the entire town square in one throw. Every real dog joined the chase, followed by an increasingly annoyed dog walker.
lore.legendary: Yorella was cast into the deepest well and returned carrying a lost bell from the bottom. Since then every vanished toy in the village has found its way home by following her spinning string.
